nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: It's on. Tonight, Vane's bank finally gives something back: every deed his pen invented, sitting in a strongbox on the wagon out behind it.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: Take this first. Pocket watch. It steadies your hand and slows your eye. Don't ask how — the patent office certainly didn't.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: It ticks PRECISELY. Everything else in this town ticks funny.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: Paid to hold lanterns and look stern. Stay out of the light — they're mostly stern.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: The lantern men are paid to look stern. Stay out of the light and they'll stern at nothing all night.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: Slip round the back, shoot the lock — the LOCK, Cole — take the deeds, whistle Biscuit, and make some noise on the way out so the posse trips over itself. Moon's up. Go.

choices.text: Plan's simple. That's what worries me.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: Simple plans have fewer parts to squeak. Trust the engineer.
